name: AI Model Engineering
description: Prepares training/evaluation data, trains or fine-tunes a model against a defined objective, and evaluates its quality, bias, and performance before it is fit to serve — the discipline generic software-construction doesn't cover.

checklists.name: AI Model Engineering Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist before a trained model is accepted as fit to serve.

items.statement: The training data's provenance, scope, and known gaps are documented in the Training Data Specification.
The model has been evaluated against every quality, bias, and performance criterion the requirement baseline calls for, not a convenience subset.
Known limitations and failure modes are disclosed in the Model Card, not just the metrics that passed.

reviewGates.name: Model Evaluation Review
reviewGates.statement: The Model Evaluation Report has been reviewed and the model is accepted as fit to serve.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the evaluation evidence — including disclosed bias and limitations — justify serving this model?
